summary: Specifies DCCP-UDP, an alternative encapsulation of the Datagram Congestion Control Protocol that lets DCCP pass through current NAT middleboxes without modifying them. It also updates an earlier specification. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Some doors only let one kind of package through. DCCP-UDP wraps DCCP packages inside the kind that is allowed, so they can get past.

questions: how does dccp work through nat
